title: Sapling Tree Gen
summary: Parametric trees and bushes (Weber-Penn method): 29 species presets, seeds, leaves, optional armature and wind, baked to meshes for .glb export.
useWhen: A level needs trees, bushes or palms in several variations and modelling each by hand would be slow; generate them by preset and seed and keep them low-poly.
avoidWhen: A few stylized blob trees built from cones and spheres are enough.
